text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, King Halo held a fan event
with Beauty Anshizawa as a guest.

text_block_list.name: Fashion Magazine Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"What truly magnificent outfits...!
I look forward to hearing all the details from the two of you later."

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Nfufu♪ Since I'm being super-duper particular about it,
it'll definitely take until evening☆

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Colors, silhouettes, materials, themes...
I shall tell you all about the meticulous craft of a
first-class Umamusume and a first-class designer!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Ohohohoho♪
Oh-ho-ho-ho♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Bzz bzz)

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Oh? Pardon me a moment...――

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Wait, what!? Right now!?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh dear, forgive me. I just got a message
from the girl whose Racewear I'm making...

text_block_list.name: Party Staff
text_block_list.text:
...Pardon the interruption, ladies.
King-san, Beauty-san.
It's time to get ready for your interview!

text_block_list.name: Participants
text_block_list.text:
—Ooh! Looks like it's starting soon!
—What do I do, I'm so excited...!
—Think we'll get to hear some behind-the-scenes stories!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...I've decided!
The joint discussion is being changed to King's solo interview!"

text_block_list.name: Beauties
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is there a problem?
Just so you know, when it comes to this racing outfit,
Miss Beauty and I are of one mind!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
We talked every day, shared our wishes and attention to detail,
worried and brainstormed together to make this absolute masterpiece♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: In other words, King alone is enough to tell the tale. —So you see, Beauty-san.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "You should go to the person on the other end of that call. This time, it's for her 'ultimate racewear.'"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now, everyone understands, right?
――From here on out, it's King's solo stage!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the event ended and I saw off the departing guests,
I reflected on the moments of the day.
choice_data_list: That was a quick call to send Beauty home.
That was a quick call to send Beauty home, huh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Did you forget?
My mother is a racing silk designer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: She was often called away out of the blue, too.

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I know it's sudden, but I'm heading out for a meeting.
...Oh, the picnic? Sorry, but ask the housekeeper to—

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
âAh, hello?
Yes, absolutely. We shall tailor the finest outfit for you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
(I stared at that closed door over and over.
Waiting for someone who might never come back...)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
(I didn't understand why I was being left behind.
――But...)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
(The first time I watched a girl wearing Mother's racing silks run.
When she crossed the finish line in 1st place...)

text_block_list.name: Young King
text_block_list.text: ......Amazing.

text_block_list.name: Young King
text_block_list.text: Mother's dress is so sparkly...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
(The racing silks, and the Umamusume wearing them.
Everything sparkles so brightly, it makes my chest ache――)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A Racewear isn't something you can wear over and over.
It's an outfit that might only have a single race of life in it.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That is why we Umamusume pour
every ounce of our feelings into that single moment.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And for that single moment, a designer devotes
their time, their spirit... absolutely everything.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why it is so special... and why I yearn for it so helplessly."
choice_data_list: ...Then let's wear it a whole bunch of times!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Again and again, to make all the time and feelings invested worth it.
choice_data_list: Let's enter way more GⅠ races!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
O-ho-ho-ho! Well, naturally!
I am King Halo, after all!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Enter, enter, keep entering! I'm gonna race
so much that this outfit wears down to threads!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Again and again, to make all the time and feelings invested worth it.
choice_data_list: Let's enter lots more! GⅠ races, that ish!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Why did you stumble over your words right there, you klutz!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Again and again, to make all the time and feelings invested worth it.
choice_data_list: I'll show my mom what I'm made of in this outfit!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
O-ho-ho-ho!
I intended to do that even without you telling me! And so—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'll make you regret not making my racing outfit from the bottom of your heart!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Again and again, to make all the time and feelings invested worth it.
choice_data_list: I'll show my mom what I'm made of in this outfit!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder about that.
Though I wouldn't get my hopes up...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That would be exhilarating.
